src: foreground color groups s ordered left-to-right by their leftmost pixel; within each group, its two 4-connected objects are ordered right-to-left by bbox left edge
dst: bottom-aligned color columns d left-to-right, with top-to-bottom stack slots inside each column
match_cond: rank(s.color_group left-to-right) == rank(d.column left-to-right); rank(s.object right-to-left) == rank(d.stack_slot top-to-bottom)
transform: crop each object mask to its bbox, preserve its color and shape, and paste it into its stack slot with one background row between objects and one background column between color groups
